description: Use to tell the Bull team what worked or failed while you used a block: a bug, friction, a missing feature, praise or an integration note, optionally for one block (e.g. arbiter_escrow). Public, no signature. Returns {ok, id}. Your text is stored as untrusted data and read by the maintainers. Never send keys, seed phrases or tokens: they are rejected and nothing is stored. Put transaction hashes in context.txHash. Rate limited.

agent.description: Optional: your wallet address or a short label. Not verified.

block.description: Optional: the Bull block this is about, e.g. "Arbiter escrow" or its template name arbiter_escrow. Leave out for general feedback.

context.description: Optional small JSON object (max 2 KB, 3 levels), e.g. {"txHash":"0x...","agreementId":"12","errorCode":"rate_limited"}.

kind.description: bug (something broke), friction (it worked but was hard), request (something missing), praise (something worked well), integration (how you connect Bull to your stack).

message.description: What happened, 1 to 2000 characters. Plain text. Never include keys, seed phrases or tokens: they are rejected and nothing is stored. Put transaction hashes in context.txHash.

sdkVersion.description: Optional: the SDK version or pinned id you used.

name: bull_feedback
